plan.goal: Resolve the duplicate charge issue in Oliver's August invoice
assumptions: The customer is referring to a billing error in their August invoice
The invoice data is accessible via billing APIs
The customer expects a correction or explanation
The attached contract may contain relevant billing terms

args.query: billing terms duplicate charges Oliver contract

args.subject: Regarding your August invoice duplicate charge
args.body:
Dear Oliver,

Thank you for reaching out regarding the duplicate charge on your August invoice. We are currently reviewing your invoice and contract to identify the issue. We will update you shortly with our findings or a resolution.

Best regards,
Support Team

stopping_conditions: Invoice is confirmed to have a duplicate charge and a resolution is provided
Invoice is confirmed to be correct and explanation is provided to the customer
Issue is escalated to a human agent if unable to resolve automatically
